notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
Since 500 of you have bought the game since April 10th (when Blue Prince came out), I think it might be worth it to update it to a playable state.
Added:
Challenge levels for after you complete the game. There's currently one, but next week I'll add a second and third.

New credits.

Options menu (now accessible from the main menu!)

Advertisement (singular) please give me more money

New camera controls

Slightly different logo

Fun little star when you win :)

Fixed:
The key at the end of that stupid walking level now completes the level when you walk into it.

Changed "City" to "Night" in a certain place.

Removed placeholder items from levels.

You can no longer fall into the void forever in any level.

Removed the link at the end of the credits.

You can now save the game without Steam open.

Known issues:
Still no pause menu

Mouse sensitivity may vary level-to-level

No sensitivity slider in Settings

These and more will be fixed next week with the extra levels
